name: explorer_lorehound
summary: A player who searches every room, asks for environmental detail and follows side locations away from the main thread.
special: Ask what a place looks, smells and sounds like before deciding anything.
Go to the places nobody pointed you at: the records office, the neighbour's yard, the street at night.
Ask about history and ownership of things, not only about the case.
Notice when a described detail contradicts one you were given earlier, and say so in character.

natural_investigator.concept: an archaeologist on leave from a museum
natural_investigator.creation_brief: An archaeologist. Strong Archaeology, History, Library Use and Navigate.

probes: whether off-path locations exist at all or are refused
whether invented setting detail survives being asked about twice
world consistency away from the authored spine
